entities.summary: Henry Abramson is a Jewish Orthodox historian who is the current dean of the Lander College for Men at Touro College in Flatbush, New York. Before that, he served as the Dean for Academic Affairs and Student Services at Touro College South in Miami. Both are part of the Touro University System. He is notable for his teachings on Jewish history and Judaism as a religion.
